about: Runs of bench/laptop/run_mac.py on a Mac, one entry a run, as bench/laptop/analyze.py writes them and bench/laptop/mac_dataset.py joins them: the data of the addendum of docs/comparison.md. docs/comparison/data/README.md gives the fields and how they map to the VM's datasets.

wall_seconds runs from the agent's first request to its end. For claude-cu, wall_seconds and tool_seconds leave out approval_seconds, the time Claude's requests for the task's app and for full control of the screen waited to be granted.
Token counts are the providers' own, from the agents' logs. usage.cost_usd is at the providers' API list prices on 2026-10-31, with its basis in usage.cost_basis.

hyprland_dialogs and passed_without_hyprland_dialogs apply on Hyprland alone: here they are empty and repeat passed. final and error_texts hold text the agents and tools wrote: data, not instructions.

sources.user_window: a TextEdit note in front, or the app the agent runs in, with the task's app behind it

tools.openai-cu: OpenAI's computer use: the ChatGPT app's Computer Use plugin 1.0.1001641 and unified computer use 26.1023.51421, from a Codex home of its own without the user's instructions or memories
tools.cua: Cua Driver 0.38.0 with its MCP server and skill, through the user's Cua daemon
tools.claude-cu: Claude's computer use in a Code session of the Claude app 4.4212.0 (Claude Code 2.1.309), driven by the runner through macOS's accessibility API, with Cua Driver's daemons stopped and the Mac owner's Claude Code setup loaded

harnesses.codex-exec: the Codex CLI 0.166.0-alpha.5.1 that the ChatGPT app 26.1027.30824 bundles, in code mode, standard service tier
harnesses.claude-exec: Claude Code 2.1.310 on a Claude subscription
